Pixel art with deliberate pixel clusters, charcoal black, ash grey, dark wine red and brilliant warm orange accents; same game aesthetic as reference. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background. No writing, no letters, no UI, no watermark, no extra characters. This is a new character illustration, do not reproduce the reference knight.
